market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility from US-Iran conflict and Warsh hawkish tilt. Oil and crops drive inflation prints higher. Nasdaq remains capped below record. Healthcare and energy outperform. Klarna and fintech credit under stress. Expect 2-3% VIX elevation through September.
market_outlook.long_term: Economic resilience (Barkin) supports gradual growth but inflation re-acceleration from energy and crops pressures rate path. AI consolidation and IP litigation reshape tech landscape. Solar and battery capex cycle builds through 2027. EM bonds benefit from structural USD weakness. Consumer squeeze persists with stagnant wages. 6-12 month outlook: cautious growth with sector rotation from tech to energy/healthcare/staples.
